claims.evidence: PRIDE title/description: FLT3-ITD+ AML study; MV-411 and RS4-11 cell lysates per sample protocol. Per-run cell line not decodable.
PRIDE instrument field and RAW headers (HTTP range) of all 12 files report Q Exactive.
RAW headers of all 12 files: HCD fragmentation with NCE 25.0.
mqpar.xml and txt.zip summary.txt (enzyme Trypsin/P); PRIDE protocol states tryptic digestion.
mqpar.xml main search tolerance via tools search-params.
txt.zip txt/parameters.txt: MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm (read via HTTP range of the zip central directory/local entry).
mqpar.xml; parameters.txt lists no fixed modifications.
MaxQuant DDA search of Orbitrap MS/MS (summary.txt MS/MS Submitted); top-N method in RAW headers.
summary.txt: multiplicity 1, no labels; no labelling in PRIDE protocol.
MaxQuant experiment names in mqpar.xml/summary.txt (file 8427=S1_1 ... 8441=S4_3, fraction 1).
PRIDE file list (12 RAW); txt.zip central directory lists only MaxQuant txt outputs, no run files.

limitations: Paper full text could not be read (Europe PMC fullTextXML returned HTTP 500; PMC page showed only front matter), so no claim cites the publication; PMID 31040234 is only the PRIDE-listed reference.

The mapping of the four MaxQuant experiment groups S1-S4 to cell line (MV-411 vs RS4-11), FLT3-ITD vs FLT3-WT status, or antibody/control IP is not stated in deposited files or PRIDE text; it is not decoded. Hence characteristics[cell line] (required by cell-lines template) cannot be given honestly: cell-lines template is not declared; only ms-proteomics + human are.
Because cell line is undecodable, age, sex, organism part, cell type, developmental stage and individual are 'not available'; no factor value column was added because no condition can be assigned.

Biological replicate numbers 1-3 follow only the _1/_2/_3 suffix of MaxQuant experiment names; whether these are biological or technical replicates is unconfirmed. Each file is a separate source row, technical replicate 1, fraction 1.
Disease 'acute myeloid leukemia' is taken from the project title/description (both cell lines are used in an AML study) rather than per-sample Cellosaurus annotation.

No fixed modifications, carbamidomethylation or alkylation reagents are stated in the deposited search parameters or PRIDE text, so none are claimed. Precursor 6 ppm is the MaxQuant main-search value from mqpar.xml.

txt.zip (377,852,379 bytes) was listed by HTTP range on its central directory: contents are txt/ MaxQuant tables (allPeptides, evidence, msms, peptides, proteinGroups, summary, parameters, etc.); no deposited run names inside, so only the 12 top-level RAW files are claimed.
RAW headers (first ~400 kB, all 12 files) show embedded paths D:\Data\<name>.raw matching file names, so no duplicated/mislabelled files detected.

SANDBOX ONLY (independent review FAIL): the S1-S4 groups cannot be mapped to MV-411 / RS4-11 cell lines or FLT3-ITD vs FLT3-WT from PRIDE, mqpar.xml or the (non-open-access) paper, so cell line, cell type and the experimental factor are missing. Disease is 'acute myeloid leukemia' for all rows from the project title, but RS4;11 is a B-cell ALL line, so this may be wrong for some rows once the mapping is known. HCD/NCE 25 come from RAW headers.
